run_factorize_sol_analysis: run the factorize_sol script on a folder or sweep directory to analyze tensor factorization solutions and print statistics
analyze_solution_tensor_factorization: analyze three matrices A, B, C for tensor factorization patterns and categorize components by order-2 and order-3 solution types
analyze_component_permutation_decomposit: analyze a 3xQ tensor F by finding the best permutation and decomposing it into two components with error measurement
check_component_type_classification: check and classify a component matrix as order-2 or order-3 types like xi, nu, 4c, syn, or syn-ab with parameters
summarize_factorization_statistics: summarize factorization results into error rates, non-factorable ratios, and solution type distributions for 4 and 6 frequency groups
